subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire this broad field-report issue now, or keep it open as the umbrella until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked?
rationale: Current main proves partial fixes but not complete closure, and the remaining work spans product/default policy across config recovery, channel catch-up, cron resource behavior, and setup/update UX.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, preserve this report as evidence, and close it once the durable trackers are complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad field report while maintainers continue auditing unresolved production-use findings here.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close with links to the strongest active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, preserve this report as evidence, and close it once the durable trackers are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-surface product-routing and issue-hygiene choice, and Peter Steinberger has the broadest observed history across the affected docs, config, cron, and Discord surfaces.
